intentComment: STEP 2.3 (final, of MIGRATE SAGA 2 - InPlaceMigrator route: 2.1 deploy -> 2.2 migrate -> 2.3 rewire) - repoint StableYieldAccumulator to the new DOLA/USDC strategies (ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2), retire the old ones (0x90ce.., 0x90af..), run final verification gates. No address change (repoint = registry setters, does NOT touch mainnet-addresses.ts).

broadcast.note: Broadcast first runs the preview variant (impersonated dry-run) then the real ledger-signed broadcast. NO --skip-simulation here (unlike 2.1/replace-sya), so the broadcast leg re-simulates.

jsChain.note: EMPTY - no node pre/post scripts. Unlike replace-sya/saga2.1-deploy/rewire-sya-to-phlimbo-v2 (which run backup-mainnet-addresses.js + a patch-mainnet-addresses-*.js), 2.3 has NO patcher. Confirms the '#No address change' intent: 2.3 is a pure on-chain registry repoint, mainnet-addresses.ts is untouched. Same pattern as saga2.2-migrate (also no JS chain).
